# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU reliability and rendering correctness**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 integrates upstream m158 fixes for GPU failures, image filtering and glyph rendering. The native update preserves managed APIs and bindings while improving allocation checks and handling of driver errors.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh flush failure handling** — Propagates draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment drops the flush's work but remains nonfatal, leaving the context usable. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Safer Imagination GPU resource handling** — Rejects oversized multisampled attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices. After Vulkan descriptor-allocation out-of-memory errors, affected pools are deliberately abandoned rather than unsafely destroyed; Graphite rejects a null pool handle. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Correct image filtering and draw order** — Prevents unwritten scratch texels from entering Ganesh image-filter output, clips destination reads to their bounds, and resets Graphite depth tracking after full-overwrite draws to preserve painter order. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Consistent FreeType LCD glyph bounds** — Corrects LCD16 coordinate conversion and cropping when glyph bounds change between loads, validates bitmap format and dimensions, and guards outline translation and image buffer bounds. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))

## Security

- **Checked GPU buffer sizes** — Checks Ganesh alignment, padding and element-size arithmetic, rejects invalid sizes, makes CPU buffer allocation fallible, and caps block and vertex-chunk allocations to prevent overflow-driven out-of-bounds writes. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
